learning.title: Training
learning.daysLate: {n} days late | {n} day late | {n} days late
learning.video.processingHint: The video is being made ready for phones. It plays once this is done; the page refreshes by itself.
learning.kpi.peopleHint: People in your branches with at least one mandatory course
learning.kpi.watchedHint: Time spent on video lessons since Monday
learning.overview.description: Mandatory training, who is late, and how much your people learn.
learning.overview.complianceBody: {done} of {people} people have finished all of theirs.
learning.overview.noCoursesBody: Put lessons, knowledge base pages and quizzes in order and make the course mandatory for the positions that need it.
learning.overview.processing: {n} videos are being prepared | {n} video is being prepared | {n} videos are being prepared
learning.chart.title: Minutes watched
learning.chart.subtitle: The last two weeks
learning.chart.empty: No lessons watched in these two weeks
learning.courses.description: Lessons, pages and quizzes in order, for everyone or some positions.
learning.courses.newHint: Give it a name; the steps, the audience and the deadline come next.
learning.courses.emptyBody: A course is a few lessons, pages and quizzes in order. Make it mandatory, and new people get it on their first day.
learning.courses.dueDays: {n} days to finish | {n} day to finish | {n} days to finish
learning.courses.renews: renews every {n} months | renews every {n} month | renews every {n} months
learning.course.title: Course
learning.course.name: Name
learning.course.mandatoryHint: Everyone it is for gets it, new people too, with the deadline below.
learning.course.dueDaysHint: Counted from the day someone gets the course. Empty: no deadline.
learning.course.renewHint: People take it again this many months after finishing; it opens 14 days early.
learning.course.sequentialHint: A step opens once the required steps before it are done.
learning.course.sequentialOff: Steps can be done in any order
learning.course.certificateHint: A numbered PDF certificate when someone finishes it.
learning.course.archiveBody: Nobody sees it any more; assignments and certificates stay and come back when you restore it.
learning.course.done.publish: Published: people it is for can now see it
learning.audience.allHint: Every approved person of the company (narrowed to the branches below, if any).
learning.audience.allLesson: Every approved person of the company.
learning.audience.positionsHint: Only people in the positions you pick.
learning.step.addHint: A video lesson, a knowledge base page or a quiz.
learning.step.removeBody: The lesson, page or quiz stays; people who haven’t finished the course no longer need it.
learning.step.emptyBody: Add the lessons, pages and quizzes, in the order people should go through them.
learning.people.reminded: Reminded {n} people | Reminded {n} person | Reminded {n} people
learning.people.newDueHint: The end of that day. Empty: no deadline.
learning.people.exemptBody: They won’t need to do this course and get no more reminders about it.
learning.people.cancelBody: What they did stays in their history.
learning.people.emptyMandatory: Once the course is published, everyone it is for gets it within the hour.
learning.people.emptyOptional: Assign it to people, or let them start it on their own from the app.
learning.assign.title: Assign to people
learning.assign.hint: They hear about it in Telegram and find it in the app.
learning.assign.dueHint: Empty: the course’s own days to finish.
learning.assign.done: Assigned to {n} people | Assigned to {n} person | Assigned to {n} people
learning.lessons.description: Video lessons, uploaded or from YouTube, and who watched them.
learning.lessons.newHint: Give it a name; the video and the notes come next.
learning.lessons.emptyBody: Upload a short video from a phone or paste a YouTube link: how to receive goods, the cold chain, the till.
learning.lesson.title: Lesson
learning.lesson.name: Name
learning.lesson.namePlaceholder: For example: The fridge and the thermometer
learning.lesson.summaryHint: Shown under the title in the app.
learning.lesson.youtubeHint: A watch, youtu.be, shorts or embed link.
learning.lesson.badLink: This isn’t a YouTube video link
learning.lesson.notesHint: What to remember, below the video. Pictures go on knowledge base pages.
learning.lesson.notesPlaceholder: The main points of the lesson…
learning.lesson.noPictures: Pictures belong on a knowledge base page: add the page as a step of the course.
learning.lesson.topicsHint: The tutor suggests this lesson to people weak in these topics.
learning.lesson.deleteBody: Its video and who watched it go too. No course uses it.
learning.upload.title: Drop a video here or pick a file
learning.upload.hint: MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV, up to 2 GB and 3 hours. It is made into a 720p video for phones.
learning.upload.label: Upload
learning.upload.interrupted: The upload stopped. Check the connection and carry on from where it stopped.
learning.upload.done: Uploaded: the video is being prepared
learning.grid.description: Everyone in your branches against the mandatory courses.
learning.grid.noCoursesBody: Make a course mandatory and this grid shows who has done it.
learning.person.title: Training
learning.settings.title: Training
learning.settings.completion: A video counts as watched at
learning.settings.completionHint: Of the video really played; skipping ahead never counts.
learning.settings.speedHint: Playing faster counts as this speed.
learning.settings.remindHint: 0: no reminder. Late people hear on the first late day, then every 3 days.
learning.settings.escalateHint: Days late. Their department head hears, else the training managers. 0: never.
learning.settings.catalog: People may start optional courses on their own
learning.settings.catalogHint: Courses meant for them show in the app’s catalogue.
learning.settings.certificatesHint: For courses that have one, a PDF with a number when someone finishes.
learning.settings.limitHint: Uploads that would go over it are refused.
